sections.Profile:
Flipper Cowboy , produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1962, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine themed around the American West. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, this single-player machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, and an animated backbox where a cowboy character "shoots" at targets.
